fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satire on Miami-area civic and political affairs, including the campaign to force Swami Yogananda to stop lectures/leave town and an attorney’s letter framing the matter as one of American liberty and due process. Other commentary addresses election politics and county governance, the impact of restrictions on racing and other amusements on tourism and nightlife, and claims of outside lobbying against Florida as a winter playground. Local columns cover Miami and Miami Beach concerns such as taxicab rates, traffic lights on Biscayne Boulevard, parking in Dallas Park, hotel guest safety and reported robberies, and civic publicity efforts; the issue also contains entertainment and sports notes (including boxing) and extensive local advertising.
